body:
I really suck at writing these things so I'll just give the tl;dr version
took the ald52 and 3-meo-pce first, once they started to peak I took the o-pce (all oral/sublingual)
-didn't drown
-was very awesome
-would do again but instead of 2 ald52 blotters I'd take 1 ald52 blotter and 1 eth-lad or al-lad blotter or some 4-ho-met/2c-e/4-aco-dmt/.... something more visual
-still it was fantastic swimming during it and everything looked so beautiful (the ships, the sea, the trees, ....)
-felt very safe the whole time
-played with a ball and some friends during it and actually caught the ball most of the time
One of the best trips ever, too bad I didn't have anything more visual, but I sure will next time.
